difficulty_reason: The author constructs multiplication and inversion on possibly infinite permutation-labelled ordered trees by coinduction, proves E-unitarity, identifies the natural order structurally, and constructs a unique maximal representative by recursively removing fixed idempotent tails. The final F-inverse property uses a compatibility/minimum-group-congruence argument. These interacting coinductive and inverse-semigroup constructions support H2 as one main structural result, rather than counting its short final consequence or each support lemma separately.
